<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Aura" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=206" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 388

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 30-foot emanation

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

Shades and spirits howl and whirl around you in a display that strikes fear into the hearts of all who witness it. Enemies in the area are [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) and can't reduce their frightened value below 1 for the spell's duration.
name: Spiral of Horrors
